_note: Baidu photos of the terminal canopy and a dusk apron view, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

pdx-baidu-1.webp.zh: 夜幕初降时的波特兰机场：停车楼与航站楼之间架起波浪形的玻璃顶棚，车灯在下方拉出光轨。
pdx-baidu-1.webp.en: At nightfall at PDX, the wavy glass canopy between the parking garage and terminal, car lights streaking along the roadway below.

pdx-baidu-2.webp.zh: 暮色中的波特兰机场：机坪上停满客机，航站楼灯光亮起，远处的水面在余晖中泛光。
pdx-baidu-2.webp.en: PDX at dusk, airliners parked across the apron as the terminal lights come on and water glints on the horizon.

pdx-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，波特兰国际机场（PDX）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
pdx-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Portland International Airport (PDX) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
